name: program-runtime.weekly-debt-ledger
purpose: Publish a reproducible weekly debt snapshot from owner APIs, compare adjacent snapshots, and calculate approach yield only from source-attributed reduction receipts.

window_start.description: Inclusive UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) for this seven-day snapshot window.

window_end.description: Exclusive UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD); must be exactly seven days after window_start.

max_scenarios.description: Upper bound on scenario file-metric reads; the roster stays visible when capped.

max_journal_rows.description: Per-scope journal read cap; a saturated scope is marked incomplete.

detector_snapshot.description: Optional owner CLI recommendation snapshots with scenario, Code Facts source hash, and returned recommendation rows; every target must match the current source hash.

lifecycle_snapshot.description: Optional retained Flow Verifier evidence with observed_at, artifact path, SHA-256, scenario_count, candidate_count, and persisted_count. Must be inside the requested week; cite the original artifact and do not treat as live inventory.

publish_snapshot.description: Append the immutable weekly report to Source Ledger debt-ledger-snapshots for next week's cross-run trend. Test fixtures set false.

assumptions: Flow Verifier owns the scenario roster and Code Facts owns current lexical file metrics; a missing or incomplete response is unknown, not zero.
Template Manager owns current template-debt rows.

A landed-reduction receipt is valid only when its before/after revisions, complete path/language/category added/deleted boundary, validation references, source stream, scenario, and controlled approach tag are present.
The Source Ledger debt-ledger-snapshots scope retains the prior report across agent-run boundaries; adjacent week windows are comparable only when their dates are contiguous and their schemas match.

Flow Verifier lifecycle inventory is deliberately not called here; its live all-fleet CLI did not return within the observed 45-second window and the charter forbids retrying or diagnosing that route in this unit. A valid caller-supplied saved artifact may be reported with its original as-of date and SHA-256.
Programs-phase fixtures use live owner reads but disable snapshot publication; deterministic tests cover missing sources, receipt validation, line aggregation, and week adjacency.
invariants: All reports distinguish absent evidence from measured zero.
Code Facts production line counts use FILE_METRICS line_count for role=implementation and retain target source/config hashes.
No recommendation estimate is presented as landed savings.
Reduction yield uses only valid source-attributed receipts; duplicate unit IDs are counted once.
The report uses the requested seven-day half-open UTC window and claims trend only for an immediately adjacent prior window.
The program prints one bounded JSON envelope and appends one immutable snapshot only when publish_snapshot is true.

budget.async_reason: A fleet Code Facts snapshot reads multiple scenario owners and must be submitted asynchronously with one server-owned wait.

fixtures.note: This executes one real owner snapshot; fixture execution does not write snapshot history.

signals.previous_window: Adjacent prior snapshot identity or unknown.
signals.snapshot_write: Whether the current immutable weekly snapshot was stored, skipped, not requested, or failed.
signals.weekly_snapshot: The retained report payload: per-scenario production line counts, Code Facts hashes, owner counts, source receipts, approach yield, and coverage.
signals.line_trend: Current minus prior weekly role counts only for matching complete scenario rows; unattributed fleet delta.
signals.source_trend: Adjacent-week landed-unit and net-line deltas by source, plus per-approach yield comparison; measured only when both full source populations are complete.
signals.detector_snapshot: Owner CLI recommendation groups keyed by scenario and the matching Code Facts source hash, or unknown.
signals.lifecycle_inventory: Current live route remains unknown; a caller-supplied saved artifact may carry dated candidate and persisted counts with path and SHA-256. Supplied evidence is not verified or treated as current coverage.
signals.template_debt: Current Template Manager row count and status breakdown, with read completeness.
signals.reduction_receipts: Validated receipts by research, ecosystem-hunt, and delivery source; incomplete streams remain unknown.
signals.approach_yield: Per-source and per-approach landed-unit count, production added/deleted/net, mean net production reduction, and boundary added/deleted lines by category and production language.

outputs.evidence: Owner binding names, requested dates, source hashes, journal IDs, and prior execution identity.
